workflows.name: Submit discovery post on AppInn with GitHub-only link
steps: Open https://meta.appinn.net/c/faxian and click 提交新发现
Fill title with concise, non-clickbait wording
Write a simple story-driven body focused on pain point and workflow
Keep only the GitHub link in the body for developer-community friendliness
Submit and confirm the post appears under 待处理 with the expected title
